#Ad - (Description contains product links). 12 Strange Signs Your Body Is Burning Fat (Not Sugar).

Fat burning is a metabolic state where your body switches from using glucose (sugar) to using stored triglycerides (fat) for fuel. This process is governed by your hormones and the activation of specific enzymes that allow fat cells to be broken down and used by your mitochondria.

A standard bathroom scale often won't tell you if you are successfully burning fat or just losing water, which is why many people get discouraged when the numbers don't move. Because fat loss is a complex internal process, your body provides subtle "fat-adaptation" signals that most people don't recognise.

For this reason, today we identify 12 common yet strange signs of fat burning to watch out for, including a metallic taste in the mouth, waking up at 3 AM, skin changes, feeling colder than usual, twitching muscles and sudden mental clarity, among others.

I also explain why these metabolic shifts happen, how to manage the "transition" symptoms, and some natural ways to support your liver and gut to keep the fat-burning process active.
